_note: The season report card. Marks are chosen by app/engine/report.py; {braces} are filled with the season's numbers (coin in ◈, shares in %).

marks.pace.A: Worth {worth}◈: {share}% of next season's Passage. Ahead of pace.
marks.pace.B: Worth {worth}◈: {share}% of Passage. Aim for {target}% by now.
marks.pace.C: Worth {worth}◈: {share}% of Passage. You need {target}%; wages alone won't get there.
marks.pace.D: Worth {worth}◈: only {share}% of Passage. The ship is leaving without you.
marks.tides.D: {idle} of {total} tides unused: about {cost}◈ left on the table.
marks.food.hungry: Your household went hungry: 2 fewer tides next season.
marks.food.card: Kelp went on your card, where it grows every season.
marks.food.dark_short: Only {stored} kelp stored for the Long Dark, when it costs {dark_price}◈ each. You need {need}.
marks.food.stocked: Fed from a cellar stocked early.
marks.food.bought: Paid {cost_at_end}◈ for kelp at the season-end price. Buying early is cheaper.
marks.safety.lost: Lost {lost}◈ to thieves and undisputed charges.
marks.safety.no_vault: All {purse}◈ in your Purse. Ione will open a Vault for free.
marks.safety.vault_locked: All {purse}◈ in your Purse. No Vault until Standing {standing}.
marks.safety.idle: {purse}◈ idle in your Purse: earning nothing, easy to steal.
marks.safety.kept: Coin safe in the Vault, earning {interest}◈.
marks.debt.reef: You owe Grin, and his fee grows by half each season.
marks.debt.missed: Missed a payment: a fee, and Standing lost.
marks.debt.interest_free: You owe {debt}◈, interest-free. Still due before you board.

chelo._note: Chelo's bullets when the AI isn't available: a 'praise' bullet for the best A mark (if any), then 'ask' bullets for the two weakest C or D marks (by mark, else by subject), else 'steady'.

praise.pace.A: You're ahead of the price of Passage. Few here can say that.
praise.debt.none: You owe nobody a coin. That's freedom.
praise.debt.interest_free: Your debt costs nothing yet. Rare in Atlantis.
praise.food.stocked: Your cellar was full before anyone thought to look.
praise.safety.kept: Your coin sat where no pickpocket could reach it.

ask.pace: Passage is {passage}◈ next season. Where does the rest come from?
ask.tides: {idle} idle tides. What would one more shift a season add up to?
ask.food.hungry: Hunger cost you tides. What would a full cellar have cost in Summer?
ask.food.card: That kelp grows on your card. Would it have been cheaper earlier?
ask.food.dark_short: Kelp is {dark_price}◈ in the Long Dark. How full is your cellar?
ask.safety.scam: Someone promised 40% a season. Who was really getting paid?
ask.safety: If a pickpocket found your Purse, what would they take?
ask.debt.reef: Grin's fee grows by half each season. How long can you owe him?
ask.debt.missed: How will the Bank remember this season?
ask.debt: What will that debt cost by the time the ship calls?

chelo.steady: If next season goes wrong, which of your choices still holds?
